25.name: Stonetalon Standstill
desc: Dispatch 12 Befouled Water Elementals at Mystral Lake, due east of the Talondeep Path and southwest of Splintertree Post.
Scout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby Alliance outpost.
Return to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
objectives: Dispatch 12 Befouled Water Elementals at Mystral Lake, due east of the Talondeep Path and southwest of Splintertree Post.
BScout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby Alliance outpost.
BReturn to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
details: If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

BThe transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path. What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.
BYou up for being useful?
completion: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens. From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends. Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...
BLooks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. Take this - you've earned it.

49.name: Sweet Amber
desc: Grimbooze Thunderbrew wants a Sack of Barley, a Sack of Rye and a Sack of Corn.
objectives: Grimbooze Thunderbrew wants a Sack of Barley, a Sack of Rye and a Sack of Corn.
details: Amber is the hue of my life's longest love$BLike the last embers of dusk in the sky above$BRetrieve for me so that my love shall be born$BOne sack of each: barley, rye and corn.
completion: Hiccup! Ho ho!

97.name: The Legend of Stalvan
desc: Report the news to Commander Ebonlocke.
objectives: Report the news to Commander Ebonlocke.
details: Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, $N! Her suspicions were correct!
completion: I knew it! Fine work, $N.

121.name: Messenger to Stormwind
desc: Take General Marcus Jonathan's letter of response to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
objectives: Take General Marcus Jonathan's letter of response to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
details: While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon.
BDismissed, $c!
completion: Thank you for your time, $C. For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.
BNow if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery. Something is amiss in our Kingdom. I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.

145.name: Messenger to Darkshire
desc: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
objectives: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
details: I require your assistance once again. I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense. It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly. You must exercise extreme caution. Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood. Do not stray from the roads.
completion: Thank you for making the long journey here. This is indeed important information.

169.name: Wanted: Gath'Ilzogg
desc: Kill Gath'Ilzogg and bring his head to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire for the reward.
objectives: Kill Gath'Ilzogg and bring his head to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire for the reward.
details: Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire.

BGath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous. He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity. The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs. A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.
completion: Fantastic work, $N! Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans. Vindication is ours. This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!

193.name: Panther Mastery
desc: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to bring him the Fang of Bhag'thera.
objectives: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to bring him the Fang of Bhag'thera.
details: You've almost proven yourself to be a master hunter of panthers. A panther by the name of Bhag'thera has been prowling the jungle. So far he's eluded our party. See if you can use your skills to kill the great Bhag'thera.
BBring me the Fang of Bhag'thera and you'll have earned my respect!
completion: So the great Bhag'thera is dead! Cheers to you, $N. You are a mighty $C indeed!

217.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
desc: Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
objectives: Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
details: $N, our scouts have identified the leader of this recent Trogg incursion. It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug. Grawmug is heavily guarded, however. Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.

BIf you feel yourself worthy, $N, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs. With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a chance at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
completion: Most excellent, $N! You have brought hope to Loch Modan. With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.

265.name: The Shadowy Search Continues
desc: See if other townsfolk have clues about the shadowy figure.
objectives: See if other townsfolk have clues about the shadowy figure.
details: Here is your book back, $N, and I bid you fortune with your search. If you ask others in town, perhaps they can offer you more clues.
BAnd here is one more for you - although the author of this book is a stranger to Darkshire, the book itself was purchased here.
completion: Ah, yes. I sold this book a month ago to a shady person. He didn't tell me his name, but he was a nervous, jittery chap, always looking over his shoulder.
BI hope that helps you...

289.name: The Cursed Crew
desc: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig. Bring Snellig's Snuffbox to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor.
objectives: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig. Bring Snellig's Snuffbox to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor.
details: <Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...>

BI am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.
BBut if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
completion: My thanks to you, $N. And the gratitude of my cursed brethren goes to you as well.

313.name: The Grizzled Den
desc: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.
objectives: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.
details: Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone. It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both! How about you? How's your mettle? Want to prove it to me?

BWell...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy. How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos. Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
completion: Ah yes, these manes will work great! You show a lot of grit, $C - I wager we'll see great things from you.

337.name: An Old History Book
desc: Return the book: The History of Stormwind, to the Stormwind Library.
objectives: Return the book: The History of Stormwind, to the Stormwind Library.
details: Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of Stormwind" can still be read along its spine. Upon opening the book, the seal of the Stormwind Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.
BIt looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...
completion: Oh my! This book hasn't rested on these shelves since before the rebuilding of Stormwind, years ago. It will have to be restored of course, it's in bad shape, but I would be honored to place it within our rare books collection.
BThank you, $N. Please accept this as payment for returning the book!

361.name: A Letter Undelivered
desc: Find Yvette Farthing, and deliver to her the letter from Thurman Agamand.
objectives: Find Yvette Farthing, and deliver to her the letter from Thurman Agamand.
details: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand. It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...
completion: Oh...my poor Thurman! I begged him to leave Agamand Mills with me and my father, but his family loyalty was too strong! And I knew it! I just knew it that Brand meant him harm!! Oh, curse this Plague, and the Scourge!
B<Yvette's face then smoothes and grows cold.>
BBut regrets are for the weak. As a Forsaken, I have new goals and love is not one of them. I would thank you for delivering this letter, for I had wondered what happened to my past love.
BBut that life is over. Forever.

385.name: Crocolisk Hunting
desc: Get 5 pieces of Crocolisk Meat and 6 Crocolisk Skins for Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.
objectives: Get 5 pieces of Crocolisk Meat and 6 Crocolisk Skins for Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.
details: Many a hunter is attracted to Loch Modan to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.

BWe do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts.
BWhy, this one time...
completion: Well now, these are excellent specimens you collected, $N. Good money for high quality materials, that's for sure.

409.name: Proving Allegiance
desc: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.
Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her.
Return to Gunther on his island.
objectives: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.
BSummon Lillith Nefara and kill her.
BReturn to Gunther on his island.
details: You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this. But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.
BThere is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island. it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.
BTake a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here. Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake. Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
completion: You have defeated Lillith Nefara, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge. Incredible.
BI had believed I was the only Undead with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.

433.name: The Public Servant
desc: Kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers for Senator Mehr Stonehallow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.
objectives: Kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers for Senator Mehr Stonehallow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.
details: As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

BThey've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.
BIf you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
completion: It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.
BThank you for your assistance, $N.

457.name: The Balance of Nature
desc: Conservator Ilthalaine needs you to kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars.
objectives: Conservator Ilthalaine needs you to kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars.
details: Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, $N, but there is still work to be done.

BThe resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed. Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land. Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
completion: You have proven your dedication to nature well, $N. A young $C like yourself has a promising future.

481.name: Dalar's Analysis
desc: Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
details: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
completion: Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.
BThat they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.
BI will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.

505.name: Syndicate Assassins
desc: Kill 12 Syndicate Footpads and 8 Syndicate Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore.
objectives: Kill 12 Syndicate Footpads and 8 Syndicate Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore.
details: I am the new magistrate of Southshore, recently assigned after the assassination of the previous magistrate. The assassins were never found, but through our investigations we're almost certain they were hired by the Syndicate - a group of thieves led by villainous nobles of the now fallen kingdom of Alterac.
BThe Syndicate has a camps in Sofera's Naze and Corahn's Dagger, north and west of the Horde-occupied Tarren Mill. Slay the Syndicate members you find in these camps.
completion: Thank you, $N. Although they may still be lurking about, we hope that some of the thieves and footpads you slew were responsible for the last magistrate's death. But even if they weren't, the Syndicate is a taint on this land and a stain on the human race.
BTheir deaths are welcome to Southshore.

529.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
desc: Kill Blacksmith Verringtan and 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmiths.
Retrieve a shipment of iron and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Kill Blacksmith Verringtan and 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmiths.
BRetrieve a shipment of iron and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
details: The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance. The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith. We need to shut down all supply lines.

BYour mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan. Slay his apprentices as well. While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile. The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing Southshore.
completion: Mission accomplished, $C. And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.

553.name: Helcular's Revenge
desc: Charge the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.
Drive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore.
objectives: Charge the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.
BDrive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore.
details: Here, take the Rod of Helcular. You will need it.

BHelcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell. The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains.

BThe Rod of Helcular must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore, the heavily guarded human town to the south. Vengeance shall be ours!
completion: A great rumbling emanates from the ground.

577.name: Some Assembly Required
desc: Bring 5 Snapjaw Crocolisks Skins to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.
objectives: Bring 5 Snapjaw Crocolisks Skins to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.
details: Well, I've got the basic shape of the boots worked out, and they're coming along fine, but the skins you brought aren't going to be quite enough for the inner layers.
B"What are we going to do, Drizzlik?" No doubt the question on your lips, and well, isn't it lucky you're talking to Drizzlik, because he's going to tell you what we're going to do!
BThe inner layers will never really be seen, so we'll just get some of the thicker, cheaper skins from the crocs around Lake Nazferiti to fill the boots out.
completion: My boots... they're like sausages, $N. Look great, taste great. I tell you they're filled with nothing but the finest ingredients and meats, and you eat it, and you love it.
BIt's safer--and more enjoyable--if you just trust me, and don't ask too carefully what's really inside.

601.name: Water Elementals
desc: Acquire 6 Water Elemental Bracers for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
objectives: Acquire 6 Water Elemental Bracers for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
details: The water elementals were no doubt summoned by Gazban, the goblin wizard rumored to have discovered the Stone of the Tides. As you may know, the Stone of the Tides curses its bearer, causing him to fade in and out of existence...

BPerhaps we can find a way to counteract the curse. We can have a mage of Dalaran analyze the magical residue of one of the water elemental's bracers. I need you to go back to the island and retrieve a few specimens.
completion: Hm, I haven't the eye to examine these bracers to see if any of them will be of any use, but I'm sure at least one of them will be able to help. Take them to Dalaran and have a mage look at them.
BAfter all, I can't very well leave Booty Bay just to chat with those tiresome old mages.
BNot that I'm worried anyone would try to elbow their way into being the new baron. No one crosses Revilgaz and lives to tell of it.

625.name: Cortello's Riddle
desc: Solve the riddle!
objectives: Solve the riddle!
details: A far off land in Kalimdor awaits$BWhere peril has dashed hopes and fates$BEast of Barrens the weather is harsh$BGloom and danger pock Dustwallow Marsh$BBut there lies a clue for those up to the test$BWaiting to be found in a cave in the southwest
completion: You find a musty scroll.

649.name: Ripple Recovery
desc: Talk to Malton Droffers in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Talk to Malton Droffers in Orgrimmar.
details: I've got some salvage work for you, and if you're an aficionado of fine ripple like I am, then you'll love this task. Ripple!
BIt's a drink, you dummy.

BAn abandoned Horde outpost has a stash of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from when they were in business. You can't get fine ripple like that anymore! One of Malton's dummy associates knows the shot, so you'll go out there and bring me a case of packaged ripple, and two for my own collection! Talk to Malton, he'll fill you in on the details.
completion: Oh yeah, about the ripple dad wants! He wants to sell the ripple to a tavern here in Orgrimmar, but we'll get more money if it is in its original packaging. I know someone who can do that, and he's in the Hinterlands where the ripple is. But he's, um, a high elf.
BWell, he's a good high elf, as he's not a part of the Alliance. Well, he's not so much a good high elf as he is a drunken high elf. He loves, and I mean LOVES the hooch.

673.name: Foul Magics
desc: Retrieve Marez Cowl's Bloodstone Orb and bring it to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
objectives: Retrieve Marez Cowl's Bloodstone Orb and bring it to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
details: There is no doubt in my mind that a powerful warlock resides within the walls of Stromgarde. From time to time, using an arcane magical relic, this warlock has summoned forth terrible demons in large numbers. We must remove the source of his energy.
BFind the warlock and kill him. Bring me whatever magical object you find on his person, and I will take steps to destroy it and see that its power is not used to taint this land any longer.
completion: My restless nights will turn to peaceful slumber when I have destroyed this orb. Thank you, $N. It is a chilling reminder of the terrible power the demons held over the orcs before Hellscream released them from their curse.

697.name: Malin's Request
desc: Take the Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
objectives: Take the Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
details: Take this letter back to Stormwind and let Malin know that Kryten an' I'll be home soon. He'll reward you well for helping us here, $N, of that I've no doubt.
BTravel safely.
completion: <Archmage Malin opens the letter, and his eyes grow wide.>
BBy the Light, you've done it. How wonderful. Trelane will be so pleased. I'm sure Kryten and Skuerto are just as excited as I am to have them on their way back to Stormwind.
BThank you, $N. Please, take this to help you in your journeys.

721.name: A Sign of Hope
desc: Find Hammertoe Grez in Uldaman.
objectives: Find Hammertoe Grez in Uldaman.
details: $N, can ye find him? Can you find Hammertoe in Uldaman?
BIf those dirty Shadowforge are holdin' him hostage to figure out what he knows about the titan excavations, then all of Ironforge could be in huge trouble.
BFor a long time now those Dark Irons have been lookin' for magics to make more powerful golems. Hammertoe was doin' the same, of course, but only to stop them.
BThey're probably keepin' him alive until they learn what he knows.Ye've got to hurry if you're gonna save him!
completion: Yes? Ah'm sorry... <cough> Feel so weak. Can ye come closer, $C?
BRyedol sent ye? Muradin be praised, that boy's not as slow in the head as I once thought. <cough>

745.name: Sharing the Land
desc: Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
details: $N, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.
BPalemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.
BWords are no longer the answer.
completion: $N, it is good you've taken my task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.

769.name: Kodo Hide Bag
desc: Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
details: The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us. If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.
BDo this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
completion: Ah, good. Thank you, $N. My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.

793.name: Broken Alliances
desc: Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones.
Place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus.
Slay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Gorn.
objectives: Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones.
BPlace the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus.
BSlay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Gorn.
details: The Seal of the Earth is held by three runestones, held in the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst in Lethlor Ravine. Using the Sign of the Earth, you will be able to remove the runestones and unlock the Seal of the Earth.
BBe wary though, $n, the black drakes Blacklash and Hematus are not to be trifled with. See them dead and return their bindings to me.
BTo reach the ravine, travel to the far eastern part of the Badlands. Be careful though, for the ravine is home to countless drakes.
completion: The black dragonflight continues to ally with the renegade Blackrock orcs, and both must be brought into line, or removed. With Blacklash and Hematus dead, we can turn our attentions westwards, towards Blackrock Spire.

817.name: Practical Prey
desc: Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.
objectives: Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.
details: Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, $N. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.
BThe time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.
BBring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
completion: I am pleased, $N. Because of your help, our people will be protected, and not go cold as the seasons change.
BThank you.

865.name: Raptor Horns
desc: Gather 5 Intact Raptor Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, and bring them to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
objectives: Gather 5 Intact Raptor Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, and bring them to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
details: The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands. And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns! If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks." I could sell them for a fortune!!!
BAnd you can help me. Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws. They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
completion: Great, you got them! Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...

913.name: Cry of the Thunderhawk
desc: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
objectives: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
details: The thunderhawk, $N, is a fierce beast. It is time for you to face them. You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.
BDo this, and your time with me will near its end.
completion: You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud. You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.
BBut your path, $N, continues. In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.
BNow, it is time to move on.

937.name: The Enchanted Glade
desc: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
objectives: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
details: I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back.
BWhen the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to Darnassus with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.
BIf you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
completion: I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, $N. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.
BI have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.

985.name: How Big a Threat?
desc: Kill 8 Blackwood Pathfinders and 5 Windtalkers and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
objectives: Kill 8 Blackwood Pathfinders and 5 Windtalkers and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
details: You've already proven adept at scouting our enemy, $N. Do you have what it takes to fight them as well?
BNot all adventurers prefer straightforward combat to the art of stealth and evasion.

BIf you think you're up for the task, then the furbolg camp south of Auberdine is currently the biggest threat to our people. You'll find some of the Blackwood tribe there. Kill 8 pathfinders and 5 windtalkers, and return to me here.
completion: Wash the blood from your garments, $N, and do not mourn what you had to do. Instead, give thanks. You have lessened the threat to our people here in Auberdine, even if Darkshore is still in jeopardy from the effects of fel moss.

1009.name: Ruuzel
desc: Bring the Ring of Zoram to Talen near the Zoram Strand.
objectives: Bring the Ring of Zoram to Talen near the Zoram Strand.
details: I fear the ancient statuette's secrets will remain forever hidden unless you find the key to its ancient lock.
BThat key is a ring, the Ring of Zoram. It belonged to the rulers of this city before the waves of the Sundering drowned it.
BFor years the ring was lost, but the naga have recently found it.
BTheir leader, Ruuzel, dwells on an isle on the northern edge of Zoram. Please, $N, retrieve the ring for me!
completion: You found the ring! Thank you, $N. Please take this as payment, and know that your deeds today will remain forever in my memory.

1033.name: Elune's Tear
desc: Bring Elune's Tear to Pelturas in Astranaar.
objectives: Bring Elune's Tear to Pelturas in Astranaar.
details: I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child. We must find more powerful medicine! Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.

BElune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... please, $N, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!
completion: Oh, you found it! I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.
BThank you! Thank you, $N!

1057.name: Reclaiming the Charred Vale
desc: Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
objectives: Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
details: As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.
BYou have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.
BThe Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.
BDrive the wretched harpies out, $n!
completion: Now that the Bloodfuries have suffered such a great loss, perhaps the true work of restoring the land can begin....

1081.name: Reception from Tyrande
desc: Find Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.
objectives: Find Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.
details: $N, I am sure Tyrande Whisperwind herself would like to thank you for taking part in this mission.
BIt may not appear so on the surface, but what you've helped start could very well strengthen our foothold in the Stonetalon Mountains.
BIf you consider yourself our ally against these atrocities, go see Tyrande in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
completion: Hello, $N. I have indeed heard your name before, and although you are still full of youth, I am pleased to see the path you have set for yourself.
BYou would do me a great honor if you would accept this as a gift of appreciation.

1105.name: Hardened Shells
desc: Bring 9 Hardened Tortoise Shells to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Bring 9 Hardened Tortoise Shells to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
details: My brother is working on a new fuel for his rocket car. He's brilliant, he really is. So brilliant that... I think that new fuel he's designing is strong enough to eat right through the car's chassis!
BI want to reinforce its fuel tanks before that happens.
BThe tortoises out on the flats have very hard shells. I want to use them to create new tanks for our rocket car. Tanks that can hold my brother's new fuel.
BYou look responsible enough. Will you get me those shells?
completion: You got them! Thanks, $N!

1153.name: A New Ore Sample
desc: Find an Unrefined Ore Sample on a Gravelsnout Digger or Surveyor and bring it to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
objectives: Find an Unrefined Ore Sample on a Gravelsnout Digger or Surveyor and bring it to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
details: $C, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

BTravelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.
completion: A good sample, $N. A good sample indeed.
BThose travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.
BI shall get to work on it immediately. If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.
BI shall not forget your help, $C.

1177.name: Hungry!
desc: Mudcrush Durtfeet in northern Dustwallow wants 8 Mirefin Heads.
objectives: Mudcrush Durtfeet in northern Dustwallow wants 8 Mirefin Heads.
details: Mud big ogre.
BMe hungry.
BGo bash fishy. Bring Mud food.
BYou feed Mud or Mud eat you.
completion: Me like fishy head!
BMe no eat you now.

1201.name: Theramore Spies
desc: Kill 9 Theramore Infiltrators, then return to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Kill 9 Theramore Infiltrators, then return to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
details: The Horde and Alliance hold an uneasy truce. Outlying skirmishes and covert actions are taken by one side against the other, and it is our duty to ensure the Horde is on top!
BNow is the chance to do just that.
BAlliance infiltrators have taken positions east of Brackenwall Village. They spy on the village and report our movements to Theramore, which we cannot allow.
BHunt down the infiltrators and slay them. Send a clear message to their superiors that we will not tolerate their spies' presence!
completion: Good work. Their infiltrators are skilled, but they're not good enough to escape the watchful eye of the Horde!

1249.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Subdue Tapoke Jahn before he escapes, and then return to Mikhail in Menethil.
objectives: Subdue Tapoke Jahn before he escapes, and then return to Mikhail in Menethil.
details: You say Elling sent you here? Well then, the hospitality I expressed is now tenfold. Anything you need, just ask. I will do my best to aid you.
BHmm, Slim, you say? Not sure the name sounds familiar, but I'll keep my eyes out for him.

BDon't look now, $N, but the gentleman over by the exit is looking over here. He's listening to our conversation a little too intently if you catch my meaning? If I were you, I'd do what you can to subdue him before he makes a break for the door.
completion: Caught him, huh? Good for you. I'm surprised that was Slim.

BI'll be honest, I never thought I'd miss the excitement of some of the more devious underground activities. I guess old habits die hard. Don't mention that to Elling--he'd probably try and get me to come back to Stormwind if he heard I missed the action.
BI'm glad I could at least be of a little service to you while you were in Menethil. If you need anything else, just ask.

1273.name: Questioning Reethe
desc: Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe, then return to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe, then return to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
details: It took a long time, but I found Reethe. He hide good for a human.
BOgron worried that he might be crazy after so much time in swamp. You come with me for we go get answers from him.
completion: Hmph. It is good that Reethe will no longer be lurking around the swamp, but it is a shame that humans are built so frail that he could not recover from a little arrow wound.
BIt seems that this thread of the mystery has led nowhere, and we must look elsewhere.

1321.name: The Black Shield
desc: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
details: Hmm... I don't see anything out of the ordinary with this shield. We should have Do'gol, the blacksmith, take a look at it, and see if he can tell us more about it, but I wouldn't hold out hope...
completion: This is good shield. Very strong, heavy, good. But Do'gol don't need it. I make shields, not buy them, $n.
BYou should know that.

1369.name: Broken Tears
desc: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village.
objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village.
details: The Gelkis think our centaur mother, Theradras, protects us. They are stupid. No one protects the centaur. The Magram do not need protection! We are the strongest!
BShow the Gelkis they are stupid. Go to the cave in their village. They hoard crystals in that cave, the tears of Theradras. Destroy the tears and bring me the broken pieces!
completion: You got the tears! Now the Gelkis will know that Theradras will not help them. She will not cry when we crush them! The Magram will rule!
BYou are smart to help us, $N. We are the strongest.

1393.name: Galen's Escape
desc: Escort Galen out of danger, then find his camp in the Swamp of Sorrows and open his strongbox.
objectives: Escort Galen out of danger, then find his camp in the Swamp of Sorrows and open his strongbox.
details: Please help! These creatures are going to eat me!
BHelp me out of here, and I'll give you a great treasure! It's in my camp in the swamp north of Stonard, but it's locked in a strongbox that can be opened through a trick that only I know.
BIf you help me escape, then I'll teach it to you.
completion: The keyhole of this strongbox is filled with black resin. It is impossible to open.
BBut Galen told you of a hidden latch on the box's bottom...
B...After a quick search the latch is found. The latch is flipped, and the strongbox opens...

1465.name: Vahlarriel's Search
desc: Return the Malem Pendant to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
objectives: Return the Malem Pendant to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
details: As you continue your search of the wagon you find not only a pendant, but also footprints leading off towards the south. In the distance you can see smoke rising from a large fort. The smoke is from a kept fire, not the burning of buildings, and your instincts tell you that the Malems, if still alive, were taken that direction.
BYou think Vahlarriel at Nijel's Point should not only see the pendant you've found, but also know about the signs of life to the south.
completion: Infuriating! This entire fiasco!
BThe two of them were warned about how dangerous coming here would be. Now they're both missing... or worse.
BYou said you saw tracks heading to a fort nearby? That may be our best bet.

BFrom what the locals have said, that fortress is infested with members of the Burning Blade--orcs who have dedicated themselves to demon causes. They may not represent the majority of the Horde's beliefs, but they are evil and will slay you on sight if you're caught spying.

1489.name: Hamuul Runetotem
desc: Speak with Hamuul Runetotem.
objectives: Speak with Hamuul Runetotem.
details: The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen. I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land. It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.

BThe Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint. But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid. I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens. He is wise, and can offer you counsel.
BYou will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.
completion: I bid you greetings, $N. You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength. For the task we now set before you ... is a dire one.

1513.name: The Binding
desc: Using Dogran's Pendant, summon and subdue a succubus, then return Dogran's Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Using Dogran's Pendant, summon and subdue a succubus, then return Dogran's Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
details: Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, $n. Summon forth a foul succubus, then show it your mastery. I believe in the strength of your magic. As always, though, be wary, for pride and overconfidence has overcome many a promising warlock.
BWhen you have defeated it, return the pendant to me so that I might deliver the news to Zankaja.
completion: Success! Be sure I expected nothing less from my star pupil.

BYou have proven your worth, and gladly will I show you the method of summoning your subdued succubus. Go now, you have much to learn, and when next I see you, I will expect you to have found true mastery over your succubus.
BLeave the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja to those of us who are longer in years, but remember it, and hold it as protection against the wiles of the dark power you have learned to summon today.

1657.name: Stinking Up Southshore
desc: Toss three Forsaken Stink Bombs into the heart of Southshore in Hillsbrad, and return to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade.
objectives: Toss three Forsaken Stink Bombs into the heart of Southshore in Hillsbrad, and return to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade.
details: Celebrate Hallow's End in style... by bringing grief to our enemies in Southshore!

BTake one of these specially crafted stink bombs. It is filled with an odiferous funk that no human - or any weak-willed beast for that matter - can stand to smell. You'll need to throw it right in the heart of Southshore for it to do its job, so be prepared for a fight against the Alliance!
BWhen you've completed this task... this tribute to our liberation, return to me!
completion: Ah, well done! I hope the Alliance chokes on the foul gift we've given them, much like we were forced to choke on the yoke of enslavement to the Scourge!

BYou've kept the ideas of Hallow's End true, $N, and for that I salute you. As an extra bonus, let me share some of these Hallow's End treats I have with you. I think you might find them to be quite the enjoyable diversion!

1681.name: Ironband's Compound
desc: Bring a load of Umbral Ore to Tormus Deepforge in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring a load of Umbral Ore to Tormus Deepforge in Ironforge.
details: My mentor, Sturgy Ironband, had a compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. There he taught blacksmithing and he was the best.

BBut one day, one of his students brought him a load of strange ore. Master Ironband called it umbral ore and was eager to work with it, but soon after it arrived... a band of Dark Iron dwarves attacked his compound. They killed everyone!
BEnter Ironband's compound, $N, and avenge my master's death. And bring me the load of umbral ore that caused it.
completion: You found it! Well done!
BI hope you killed a host of Dark Iron dwarves while searching. I fear that Ironband's compound won't be the last place we see them.
BBut thank you for the ore, $N. I'm eager to work it and find its properties.

1705.name: Burning Blood
desc: Bring 20 vials of Burning Blood and 1 Burning Rock to Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring 20 vials of Burning Blood and 1 Burning Rock to Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.
details: I hate to admit that Furen might have really found something. But to be sure I'll need to try his techniques on a new piece of armor. If you help me with the materials, $N, then you can have the armor.
BTo make this armor, I need samples of burning blood and a burning rock.
BThe only place I know to get them is Duskwood. The Nightbane worgen based in the Roland's Doom mine have burning blood, and their leader Gutspill will have the rock.
BMay fortune grant you speed, $N.
completion: Nice work! Now if you'll excuse me, I have some work to do myself...

1801.name: Tome of the Cabal
desc: Speak with Jorah Annison in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak with Jorah Annison in the Undercity.
details: It will take more than a simple summoning circle to bring forth a felhunter for you to challenge.

BMy three acolytes and I will assist in creating the magic circles. You require a copy of the Tome of the Cabal, which has been lost to us for some time. It was written by the first group of warlocks to summon a felhunter unaided.
BPerhaps Jorah Annison can help you with this. He's employed as a cartographer in the Undercity these days, but still knows more of ancient texts than any I know.
completion: Map making! Pictures, estimations of reality. I have no use for such things.
BIn books, narrative, description! That is where truth lies. I would trade all the maps in this store for one book on the rise of necromancy, or a tale of the Dark Lady's triumph.

1825.name: Speak with Thun'grim
desc: Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
objectives: Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
details: Thun'grim Firegaze, an orc blacksmith of renown, has heard of your continued deeds of valor in service of the Horde. He would like to fashion for you a suit of armor, and bids you speak with him immediately.
BThun'grim is camped east of the Crossroads in the Barrens.
completion: Yes, you have come. This is good, for we have much to discuss, you and I.

1921.name: Gathering Materials
desc: Bring 10 Linen Cloth and the 6 Charged Rift Gems to Wynne Larson in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring 10 Linen Cloth and the 6 Charged Rift Gems to Wynne Larson in Stormwind.
details: You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe. Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials

BThe robe will be made of linen which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of Loch Modan, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.
BGather the linen and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the Mage District.
completion: Yes, these are great pieces of linen. I can make a fine robe with them. And after I weave the rift gems into it, we'll have a garment fit for a mage!

1945.name: Laughing Sisters
desc: Bring 12 Laughing Sister's Hairs to Kil'hala at the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring 12 Laughing Sister's Hairs to Kil'hala at the Crossroads.
details: For your services, I have arranged for the creation of your new robes, provided you can gather the needed materials...
BFor these robes, you must return to Ashenvale for the locks of hair from laughing sisters--dryads who gather near the Raynewood Retreat.
BWhen you have their hair, bring it to Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He will be expecting you, and will fashion your robes.
completion: Ah, this hair will weave into a fine robe, $N. It is a pity the laughing sisters had to die to part with it, though I do doubt they would ever give it willingly.
BA pity, but only a small one.

2041.name: Speak with Shoni
desc: Speak with Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak with Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
details: Perhaps... Perhaps you can help us in the battle for Gnomeregan.
BIn Stormwind you will find the commander of our underground assault crew, Shoni the Shilent. Shoni needs assistance with her gyrodrillmatic excavationators.
BYou will probably find her amongst the dwarves in Stormwind.
BGood luck, $N.
completion: Do you bring word from central command?

2161.name: A Peon's Burden
desc: Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.
objectives: Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.
details: Excuse me? Can you help me?

BI have a load of food here. I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse! I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out. But they don't need any food! Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...
BCan you take it for me? I'm just a peon, but you're a hero. You fear nothing!
BTake it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn. Thank you!
completion: Ah, this is the food Ukor brought to the Valley of Trials. Did they not need it? Well, I guess they like to starve you heroes in training. Builds spirit, they say!
BThank you for returning the food. I'll stick it back on the shelves... but here, let me offer you some refreshment first!
BAnd don't forget to rest here in the inn. You may be a brave $C ready to take on the world, but if your energy is sapped you won't be doing yourself, or the Horde, much good.

2281.name: Redridge Rendezvous
desc: Venture forth to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains and speak with Lucius.
objectives: Venture forth to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains and speak with Lucius.$B
details: Sending you out in the field now would be suicide. Renzik doesn't need another dead rogue on his hands. Don't fret, though, $N - Renzik is going to get you up to speed.
BMake your way to the Redridge Mountains and speak with an associate of SI:7 named Lucius. You will find him hanging around the docks of Lakeshire with the other shady good-for-nothings.
completion: Ah, so your fingers are a little fat, eh? Don't worry, $N, I've turned more useless thieves than you into accomplished rogues.

2521.name: To Serve Kum'isha
desc: In your journeys throughout the Blasted Lands, should you ever come across a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere, take the item back to Kum'isha the Collector.
Be warned, this gem is one of the most rare crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.
You will be rewarded for each Flawless Draenethyst Sphere you have collected.
objectives: In your journeys throughout the Blasted Lands, should you ever come across a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere, take the item back to Kum'isha the Collector.
BBe warned, this gem is one of the most rare crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.
BYou will be rewarded for each Flawless Draenethyst Sphere you have collected.
details: $R, can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.

BSo you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, $r... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.
completion: Do my eyes deceive me? Impossible! Where did you... How...
BPerhaps now a rift can be opened, returning us to our homeland.

2641.name: Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient
desc: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan wants you to collect a Violet Tragan and return it to her.
objectives: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan wants you to collect a Violet Tragan and return it to her.
details: When I was a kid, my sister used to do all the cooking. It was horrible! I could barely stomach some of her concoctions -- until I found what I like to call my "secret" ingredient! Add it to anything, and... WOW! It tastes great!

BWhat is it, you ask? It's a mushroom called the Violet Tragan. If you want me to help you turn this horrid-tasting brew into something edible, head to the Hinterlands, and look for a small lake there.
BOh, and remember, the Violet Tragan can only be found underwater.
completion: That's the stuff, $N!
BIt looks so good, I might just... Haha, gotcha!

2761.name: Smelt On, Smelt Off
desc: Bring forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.
objectives: Bring forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.
details: Many blacksmiths believe that mining and smithing are separate, independent jobs; but can there be blacksmithing without mining? Ah ha -- it is an impossibility! The accomplished blacksmith must also be an accomplished miner.
BShow Galvan that you are capable, $N. Bring me forty bars of iron and forty bars of mithril. For this, Galvan will teach you the ways of the ornate mithril pants!
completion: Your work ethic is impeccable, $N! You are starting to understand the ways of Galvan mineralogy! Take this and learn from it all that you can.

2857.name: Wild Leather Helmet
desc: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
objectives: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
details: A Wild Leather helmet offers the wearer superior protection to the vital areas of the head without a sacrifice in comfort. As with all Wild Leather armor, the integrated wildvine yields a powerful but random magic imbuement to the helm's frame. Leather wearers will definitely want this piece!
BFor this pattern, I will need two Nightscape tunics, 2 Nightscape headbands, and a wildvine. Complete this lesson and the pattern will be yours!
completion: This Nightscape equipment you have supplied perfectly meets the requirements I have given to you, $N. I expect no less from a leatherworker of your caliber.
BYou have earned the honor of crafting Wild Leather helmets. I give this pattern to you freely, and hope you will profit from it accordingly.

2929.name: The Grand Betrayal
desc: Venture to Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque when the task is complete.
objectives: Venture to Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque when the task is complete.
details: I trusted Thermaplugg, $r. Never did I expect that he would betray me and the entire gnomish people. And for what? Power? Wealth? All things that he would have had in time. Now we have been displaced from our home and that madman is in charge. The king of nothing....
BWe will retake Gnomeregan, $N. We will not stop until the city is back in our control. If you wish to join in our fight, a simple task I ask of you: Kill the betrayer. Destroy Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
completion: I like to think that the last thing that went through his head as he collapsed to the ground was your foot, $R. With Thermaplugg dead, our plans to retake Gnomeregan are one step closer to becoming a reality.

2977.name: Return to Ironforge
desc: Speak with Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak with Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
details: You access the pedestal again; the platinum discs suddenly appear once more in your backpack.
BWith the knowledge of the stone watcher learned and the discs returned to your possession, the time has come to return to Ironforge and inform the Explorers' League of your discovery.
completion: You were missing some discs? Interestingly enough, it seems that the discs of Norgannon are only parts of the complete set - like keys on a key ring, if you will.
BIf we can find the Plates of Uldum, then we could actually access the Uldum complex itself! Imagine actually exploring the place where the Creators worked without having to bring a huge shovel!
BNot that there's anything wrong with shovels... or digging...

3001.name: Seeking Strahad
desc: Find Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
objectives: Find Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
details: I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak, nor is he your enemy... at least for now. He is powerful and should be respected. He can teach you about greater summonings, summonings I feel you are prepared for. Go to him now.
BYou can find him in Ratchet... above the port town next to the tower there.
completion: A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... so much ignorance.
BIs that hatred I see in your eyes, $N? Good, we will put that to good use.

3097.name: Hallowed Scroll
desc: Read the Hallowed Scroll and speak to Dark Cleric Duesten in the church in Deathknell.
objectives: Read the Hallowed Scroll and speak to Dark Cleric Duesten in the church in Deathknell.
details: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the priest trainer Duesten. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
completion: There is only one thing you must know: we have survived through will alone. It is faith in ourselves that separates us from others, and with our powers, we will cause great change in all of Azeroth. The weak will come to lean on you. The lepers will call you Lord. And the ignorant will look to you for guidance. It is my duty to make sure you have the necessary tools so when the time comes, you are prepared. As you grow in experience, seek me out. I will teach you greater powers if you are ready.

3121.name: A Strange Request
desc: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
details: Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar has what I need to get started here! He has mixed up a concoction that I need for my... well, you'll see.

BOff with you now -- to Orgrimmar. Here, take this with you. It's a shrunken head that I promised Neeru in exchange for the herbs. It's the head of some poor dwarf I ventured across in the forest. I'm sure Neeru will be pleased.
BYou'll find Neeru in the Cleft of Shadow.
completion: I have been waiting for Uzer'i to deliver this...
BLet me give you the herb mixture I prepared for his... well, experiments...

3361.name: A Refugee's Quandary
desc: Bring Felix's Box, Felix's Chest and Felix's Bucket of Bolts to Felix Whindlebolt in Anvilmar.
objectives: Bring Felix's Box, Felix's Chest and Felix's Bucket of Bolts to Felix Whindlebolt in Anvilmar.
details: We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong! Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.

BIn my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools. It was the trolls that got them. They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts! They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.
BI'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
completion: Huzzah, you've found them! You're an absolute savior, my friend. Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through! Thank you!

3385.name: The Undermarket
desc: Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.
objectives: Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.$B
details: They call themselves the Undermarket: Cutthroat traders that will sell, move, trade and do just about anything for the right price.
BIt gets worse, $N. They have set up a base of operations here in the Searing Gorge. Trade Master Kovic is heading up the operation and has close ties with the Dark Iron dwarves of the region.
BWe must strike hard and send a message to their leadership. Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Bring back his trader's satchel when the job is done.
BTo the Cauldron!
completion: You have struck a decisive blow against the Undermarket. Their leaders will think twice before sending more cronies into the gorge.
BOh, and I also found nothing of use in the trader's satchel. You may keep whatever you find inside.

3481.name: Trinkets...
desc: Open the chest.
objectives: Open the chest.
details: The chest appears locked.
completion: The chest opens at your touch. How much cheese could possibly be in here? There is only one way to find out.

3505.name: Betrayed
desc: Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori's camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.
objectives: Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori's camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.
details: I thought as much.
BWe start our crusade against her workers along the southern bluffs on the northern peninsula of Azshara. Kill them with bloody rage--let them know they've betrayed the wrong allies.

BDo not concern yourself with her yet--she spends most of her time with her bodyguards searching Azshara. It would be prudent after you've slain her workers to find her personal camp. Scouting out where we can attack her would be wise. Perhaps there is something there we can use to provoke her.
completion: You begin to skim some of the pages until you come to a page that's marked by a thin, black strip of silk cloth.

BAs you try to decipher the script, you see a diagram on the bottom of one of the pages. A quick look around at the scene before you and you realize that the crystals, the circle, and even some of the other components on the ground are set up in a similar pattern as the diagram.

3601.name: Kim'jael Indeed!
desc: Search the Thalassian Base Camp for Kim'jael's Compass, Scope, Stuffed Chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him in Azshara.
objectives: Search the Thalassian Base Camp for Kim'jael's Compass, Scope, Stuffed Chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him in Azshara.
details: Kim'jael indeed!! Do you know what Kim'jael means to the Blood elves, $N? Little rat... or something like that. The big bullies!

BThey hired me to help them scout the area looking for some sort of lost treasures. Of course I jumped aboard the moment they said "treasure" and the amount they were willing to pay, but of course, they turned on me and tried to kill me... ME!
BGoes to show you, you can't trust a Blood elf.
BThe problem is, they still have my equipment and I can't get it back. Help me out?
completion: Haha! You got them good, didn't you?!
BThis is great! That'll teach those Blood elves to betray their partners... especially someone as loyal as a goblin merchant! Bah, Blood elves...!
BWell, the least I can do for you is pay you for your time... just like I said I would.
BHere you go... those should be useful.

3625.name: Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry
desc: Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.
objectives: Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.
details: $N, the creation of each weapon will take some time.

BAdditionally, you may only use the power of the Felcurse once per three minutes. Its weakening properties against Razelikh the Defiler and his minions may be variable in duration. This is why you must release the Felcurse only when the moment is right!
BNow give me a moment to craft your weapon, $N.$B
completion: <Galvan wipes the sweat from his brow.>
BA finer demon slayer has never existed, $N.

3721.name: An OOX of Your Own
completion: You've recovered three of my OOX homing robots! You've gone above and beyond what you needed to, so I will give you something special for all your help. It is a miniature version of the very same robot that you have come to know and love, the OOX!
BI normally wouldn't let anyone have such a potentially lethal device, but you've been a real help. Besides - the combat mechanisms and the homing logic on this one have been disabled.
BOther than that, it's an OOX by golly!

3841.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
desc: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.
objectives: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.
details: Oh, hello, $N. I'm so glad to see you again. How was your trip to Darnassus?
BWell, you'll be happy to know that we've made quite a bit of progress while you've been gone. We even saved a nest full of eggs. Unfortunately, the mother died before we got to her.
BSay, would you want one for a pet? They look to hatch soon, so they'll need a good $Gfather:mother;. What do you say?
BIf you're really interested, take one of the eggs to Quentin at the race tracks in Shimmering Flats. He'll tell you more.
completion: Ah, a sprite darter egg, and one near maturation, if I'm not mistaken. Remarkable you've found one, let alone in this good a condition. They're rarely seen in Feralas these days. I understand there were various poachers in the area trying to capture and kill them for many reasons. Too bad really... such beautiful creatures when they reach adulthood.
BHow did you come across such a find?

3913.name: A Grave Situation
desc: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.
objectives: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.
details: If you return to the graveyard, $N, you will find a gravestone there... Not just any gravestone; this one will stand out from the others. Secrets lie within it.
BPush on the stone, and you will learn of these secrets...
completion: You push on the stone firmly, and it slides away, revealing a small depression underneath it.
BPlacing Linken's Sword into the depression, you realize that it fits perfectly...

3961.name: Linken's Adventure
desc: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.
objectives: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.
details: To think all this time that the reason Linken came here was to rid us of Blazerunner... He seems like such an ordinary guy, but I did notice that he's not at all interested in any of my experiments or gadgets like most gnomes would be. He must be a true warrior at heart.
BBring the totem to him. See if that helps him remember why he came here.
completion: Did J.D. help you at all?

4081.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
desc: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.
objectives: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
BWarlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.
B
details: By order of Warlord Goretooth, commander of the Kargath Expeditionary Force:
BAny and all of General Angerforge's forces within Blackrock Depths must be annihilated.

BAngerforge's men are ruthless killers, responsible for the mass murder of the 109th division of the Kargath Expeditionary Force. Heroes are warned to exercise extreme caution when confronting these brutes.
BAny person who destroys the first line of General Angerforge's forces in Blackrock Depths shall receive a tribute.
completion: This first strike should put a crease in Angerforge's pants. Now, move along soldier. I have work to complete, battles to plan, enemies to crush!
BCheck the wanted signs for more work.

4129.name: The Knife Revealed
desc: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: The Stronghold's resident druid, Quintis Jonespyre, has some... unusual skills. One of them involves psychometry - the ability to reveal an item's history by touch. Don't ask me how he does it; I chalk it up to magic I do not and choose not to understand. I do know, however, two things: one, I've seen it work and two, the bum owes me.
BTake the knife up to Quint in his little tree-house here, and tell him for me that his Kalimdor Hold 'Em debt will be paid if he works his mojo on that knife.
completion: Thank you, $N.

BWhile psychometry isn't an exact art by any stretch of the imagination, I've used it in times past to give insight into situations that others have chalked up to lost causes. I think using it on the knife you've uncovered will give us a glimpse into what happened to Raschal.
BIt will only take a moment to do, but it isn't what I'd call a caster-friendly task. Bear with me on this.

4201.name: The Love Potion
desc: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
objectives: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
details: Oh, the pains of love! My dear Private Rocknot is immune to my charms. I am spurned! It's maddening!

BYou must help me! We succubi know much of love, and I can make a potion to beat down the iron walls around Rocknot's heart. To make it, I need these items: the herb gromsblood, giant silver veins from the cliff giants of Azshara, and water from the Golakka Springs Crater in Un'Goro. You can place the water in this vial.
BPlease, $N, help a poor soul in her quest for happiness!
completion: Oh, you've done it! I can now make my potion and use it on Rocknot. Finally, he will fall victim to my charms!
BThank you, $N. You are a champion of love!

4297.name: Food for Baby
desc: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.
objectives: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.
details: Sprite darters are omnivores--that means they eat both meat and vegetation. If your egg here's gonna hatch, we best be prepared. Some good eats for these little guys are flanks of meat, raw and juicy, believe it or not. I was never able to find out why, but it has somethin' to do with Elune's plan for the elves... maybe they were to be protectors or somethin', I don't know.
BI'll take care of the egg for now, why don't you get me some good Silvermane stalker flanks for 'em to eat when he's hatched.
completion: These'll do nicely, and if I'm not mistaken, your little egg's just about ready to hatch. How does it feel? You know, you about to be a $gfather:mother;? Haha, didn't think ya'd have to deal with such responsibility, now did ya?

4321.name: Making Sense of It
desc: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.
objectives: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.
details: The information you have given me about the pylons is very interesting...
BGive me a moment to do some calculations, $N. Speak to me again in a moment and I should be able to give you the answer we have been looking for.
completion: Alright, $N. This is fascinating... I can only hope that my diagrams are correct! I compiled everything into this manual, which you can have.
BI believe I can answer any questions you have about the crystals now, $N.

4441.name: Felbound Ancients
desc: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.
objectives: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.
details: The flute you found was carved from an ancient protector, the treant allies that have faithfully protected the night elves.

BThe satyrs have been able to corrupt anything they come in contact with, which includes the ancients that made Felwood their home. By the use of the fel, the spirit of the ancient has been bound and tortured, never completely released. The felbind you found is no doubt related.
BWe must try to purify the flute, $N. Bring me blessed water from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
completion: Thank you, $N. Now, we must pray that we can undo the damage that has been done...

4489.name: Summon Felsteed
desc: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
objectives: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
details: You, $r! Come here!
BYou're the one they call $N, yes?
BI thought as much. I will keep this short: you're growing in power, and it has been acknowledged. And now, the time has come that you are rewarded for your efforts.
BGo to the Barrens. There, above Ratchet, you'll find Strahad Farsan--perhaps you remember him? He would have words with you. I wouldn't take long.
completion: So, you've decided to grace my presence again. How kind of you.
BMy acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.

4513.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
desc: Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.
If you have trouble finding them, perhaps try to get more clues from Laris.
objectives: Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.
BIf you have trouble finding them, perhaps try to get more clues from Laris.
details: I'm going to need more samples, $N. But--and I don't know how to put this--they have to be pure samples. I know, I know. "What does 'pure' mean, Laris?" I'm not sure. I do know that these are corrupt... just like Felwood. Which is what makes my realization so important. The oozes seem to adapt... to take on the aspects of the area they're in. I'll need to find samples that haven't been polluted. But where? Where?!
BBah! $N, take these containers just in case you find any on your own.
completion: You've found it? $N, you are a treasure unto yourself. Your dedication and aid has been magnificent and I could not possibly thank you enough.
BPlease, take this for your troubles. I have some work to do, but I'm sure, if you come back at a later time, I'll have need of your services again.
BThank you. Thank you so much.

4681.name: Washed Ashore
desc: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.
objectives: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.
details: That beached creature is not an isolated incident here in Darkshore. There are more along the coastline and even in the water. I would like for you to investigate another one that we know of; this one was reported to be in the water due west of Auberdine, close to a sunken vessel. Return to me with anything that you may recover that would aid our research.
BAlso, in your travels you may find other creatures. By all means, if you should discover anything then please bring it to our attention!
completion: You've been a tremendous help here today; we now have a solid chance at unlocking the mystery of why these creatures choose to beach themselves on the cost of Darkshore. The idea that they might be fleeing the area around Teldrassil is disturbing. Should you come across others in your travels, please let me know. Our research here is but in its infancy.
BOn behalf of the Temple of the Moon, please accept this as thanks for the effort you have given. Thank you, $N!

4729.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
desc: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
details: You're probably wondering what I'm doing out here. Look at the cages! Ain't it obvious?
BI'm an animal lover, first and foremost, but a salesman by trade. I track down exotic animals for the rich and famous and domesticate the beasts so they behave as proper pets.
BNow you're probably wondering, "What can I do for you, Kibler." The answer is simple: Take this here beast cage and find me some worg pups. For that, I'll domesticate a worg for you!$B
completion: You got 'em at the perfect time, $N. Any later and they'd be untrainable! Gimmie a minute and I'll have the little fella ready for you to take home.

4921.name: Lost in Battle
desc: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.
objectives: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.
details: We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.
BI awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.
BPlease, $c, find some sign of my wife.
completion: I understand. Thank you, $C.

4969.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
desc: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: Haha! You're doing very well for yourself, young $c.
BGiven time, infernals and dreadlords will bow before you!
BBut until that time comes, you must still rely on weapons forged by the hands of the mortal races.

BYou seem prepared for another such creation, and if you are willing, Menara Voidrender would speak with you! She is near Strahad's tower overlooking the port town of Ratchet. Go there when you are ready.
completion: Ah, you do seek something more... substantial. I can help you if you truly are prepared.
BIt's a welcome change to see one of our kind seeking more power in forms other than just knowledge.
BSo, do you feel you're ready, $N?

5041.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
desc: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.
objectives: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.
details: That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

BYou've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies.
