You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.
BThe people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
completion: Haha! Thank you, $N! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.

5065.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
desc: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
objectives: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
details: The troll with whom you spoke did not tell the truth. The two tablets you gained for him spoke of containing the essence of Hakkar, but there is more to that legend. I have studied long, and found that there are six Tablets of Mosh'aru, not two! Six!
BAnd I fear that we will not like what secrets the others hold..
BFind the third and fourth tablets of Mosh'aru. They're in the Eastern Plaguelands, held by the mossflayer trolls. Find them, and bring them to me.
completion: You found them! Great!
BThank you, $N. I will pour over these texts and decipher their meaning.
BYou, however, have another task...

5089.name: General Drakkisath's Command
desc: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.
objectives: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.
details: From the corpse of the defeated serpent you uncover what appears to be a note of some importance: A letter from his superior, General Drakkisath, concerning protocol.
BYour instinct tells you that you should take it to Marshal Maxwell.
completion: The plot thickens...

5161.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
desc: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.
objectives: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.
details: We understand what the cursed brood of Deathwing attempts to do and we know that it cannot be allowed.
BBecause of the protection Blackrock mountain affords Nefarian, it has become increasingly difficult for us to intercede.
BWe can, however, empower you, mortal - should you so choose.
BThe path before you is one full of peril. You must decide whether to accept our help. Ponder this and speak with me again when a decision has been made.
completion: So it shall be...

5233.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
desc: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
objectives: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
details: Two cauldrons have been successfully opened; while you'll be able to access them indefinitely, we still want to open up the other two that remain. This will provide all of us with more options to introduce the counter agent!

BThis time, you'll be hitting the Writhing Haunt's cauldron. It is almost due east of Andorhal, relatively close to the ruined city walls; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. Use this bottle to obtain the sample from the cauldron.
BGood hunting, $N!
completion: The cauldron lord's key unlocks the access panel to this cauldron and then disappears, much like the other keys have for the previous ones you've dealt of. A putrid smelling substance churns violently beneath the platform of the cauldron.
BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.

5281.name: The Restless Souls
desc: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.
objectives: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.
details: There are those that died tragically in the fall of Stratholme. Many took their own lives, opting to hurl themselves into the myriad flames of the smoldering city rather than become one of the Scourge.
BThey now walk the streets of Stratholme as restless spirits.
BWe must aid them, $N!
BI have an associate named Egan who has been doing miraculous work with ghosts and souls. Seek him out. He walks the eastern Plaguelands, near Stratholme, testing his innovations.
completion: Alen has finally found someone brave enough, eh?

5305.name: Sweet Serenity
desc: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.
objectives: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.$B
details: Within the confines of the Scarlet Bastion lies sweet Serenity. The Crimson Hammersmith guards the recipe with his life. Defeat him and bring me his apron. For that, I shall reward you with the knowledge required to create an enchanted battlehammer!
completion: May you bash in many a brain, $N!

5401.name: Argent Dawn Commission
completion: All who fight evil on behalf of the Argent Dawn must don our commission. Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer.

BWhile under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess. Procure these insignia and bring them to me. For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the Argent Dawn Valor Token.
BAchieve your destiny, $c - join the fight today!

5521.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
desc: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
details: $G Brother : Sister; $N - your deeds on behalf of the Argent Dawn are far too numerous to be recounted easily. As a fitting tribute, I'll part with one of our special Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn - a version that protects the wearer from all forms of resistible magic simultaneously. Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn are reserved for only the mightiest of the Dawn's heroes!
BBring to me twenty-five valor tokens as a sign of tribute, and I'll give you the finest of all our mantles.
completion: Most impressive, $N - the Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn is now yours!

BAs long as you maintain Exalted status with the Argent Dawn, you will be able to purchase additional Chromatic Mantles. They will be made available to you immediately from any of the Dawn's quartermasters.

5545.name: A Bundle of Trouble
desc: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
objectives: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
details: I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.
BI've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.
completion: Excellent! Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.
BThank you and farewell.

5641.name: A Lack of Fear
desc: Speak to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge.
details: $N, your High Priest Rohan would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my strong friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Rohan should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. He will be waiting.
completion: You've got the makings of a great $C, $N. Keep up the good work!
BYou've already shown you're ready for battle. Perhaps it's time we taught ya a little somethin' more.

5713.name: One Shot. One Kill.
desc: Protect Sentinel Aynasha, then speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
objectives: Protect Sentinel Aynasha, then speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
details: I was traveling to Auberdine with an important message when I was attacked by the furbolg Marosh and his trackers. During the attack I was poisoned, leaving me barely able to stand. I can make an antidote, but it will take time before it is ready.
BI would ask that you defend me until I can apply the antidote. I will aid you with my bow as best I can.
BShould we survive, I will be able deliver my message to Auberdine, while you speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post to inform her of this incident.
completion: You bring most welcome news $C. It is good to hear that Aynasha is alive and well thanks to you. I would hope that you might accept a reward for your valor. May Elune watch over you and light your path.

5761.name: Slaying the Beast
desc: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
details: The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.
BIf they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.
BKill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
completion: Ha! You've done it! Thrall will be so pleased.
BI will ensure this heart is taken care of properly.
BFor now though, you must celebrate your victory. I will inform Thrall of your success.
BThank you for your aid, $C.

5881.name: Calling in the Reserves
desc: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.
objectives: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.
details: The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

BI need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
completion: This is great news; I have been sitting here guarding this hunk of wood for too long. Now I can spend some time with my family... Yippee!

5929.name: Great Bear Spirit
desc: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
objectives: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
details: In the northwest part of Moonglade resides the home of a wise and noble being we call the Great Bear Spirit. For all druids, it has served as a tutor and mentor into the first true natural understanding of the bear. All druids at one point seek the spirit's wisdom, and you shall be no exception.

BGo to the Great Bear Spirit now and learn what it will teach. When it is satisfied with you, return to me here in Nighthaven. We will then see if you have truly taken account of the lessons it teaches.
completion: Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him. and he smiles ever so slightly.

B"I sense wisdom in you, young one, that was not present when we first met. You gaze upon me with strength and knowing intent, though this intent is yet not focused. You will now learn to focus your strength and adopt the nature of the bear into your work."

6001.name: Body and Heart
desc: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.
objectives: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
BSpeak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.
details: Directly east of Auberdine lay many moonkin caves. The one closest to Auberdine has a Moonkin Stone inside it. Lunaclaw, the defender of the stone, will face you only when Cenarion Moondust is applied to it. Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.
BYou've earned the right to use this Cenarion Moondust, $N... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
completion: You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, $N. I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.
BThere are no further obstacles in your way... let me now teach you what it means to be a Druid of the Claw!

6025.name: Unfinished Business
desc: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
details: What? Really? You want to know more? But you've already done so much for me, $N. I couldn't possibly ask you to enter Hearthglen itself on my behalf.
BAre you sure, $N? Hearthglen is much more dangerous than the Pass--I cannot provide you any protection or even information about what you might face.

BWell, if you really are willing to help, then enter the town and find a high place to gain a good view of the town. From there you can gauge their numbers and report them back to me. But be careful....
completion: You've done it, $N! Thank you!
BI'll return to Elling... I mean Stormwind as soon as I can. Here, take this coin, it's the least I can do for you. You're a credit to your people, $N. Thank you and good luck.

6073.name: The Hunter's Path
desc: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.
objectives: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.
details: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
BYou must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
completion: Yes, it is time, $c.

6121.name: Lessons Anew
desc: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
objectives: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
details: You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, $N. Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation. This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.
BTravel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.
completion: Greetings young $C, I'm glad to see you ready and eager to learn about the curing of poisons.

BWhile most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing. There has been a rash of animal poisonings in Auberdine, and the village there has been unable to cure it. To that end, a representative there has asked Moonglade for aid and we are sending you there to aid them. This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real. Bear this in mind.

6145.name: The Crimson Courier
desc: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.
Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.
objectives: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.
BTake the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.
details: Just as the body cannot survive without the head, the head cannot survive without the body. The defenses of the Scarlet Crusade's command inside Stratholme are almost impenetrable. We must, instead, cut the body out from under the head.

BMy Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, $r! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Return it to Nathanos.
completion: <Nathanos laughs.>
BExcellent! Finally! An opportunity to destroy the Scarlet Oracle!

6361.name: A Bundle of Hides
desc: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.
details: I have a bundle of hides from the animals of the Barrens, and must get them to Thunder Bluff. A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.
BWill you take the hides to him for me?
BThe quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider. Bring the bundle of hides to Devrak, our wind rider master in the Crossroads, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.
completion: If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you are speaking to the right orc!

6385.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
desc: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.
details: I've written a letter of thanks to Zargh. Will you deliver it for me? If you've already been to the Crossroads and spoken with their wind rider master, then you can fly a wind rider back there.
BTake my letter to Doras, the wind rider master of Orgrimmar, and speak with him about transport to the Crossroads.
completion: You have to get this to the Crossroads in the Barrens? Yes, I can get you there...

6481.name: Earthen Arise
desc: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.
objectives: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.
details: You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, $c. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.
BI have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.
BWhen awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, $N!
completion: You bear good news, $C! I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor.
BSlaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less then a hero. You have done well; all of Stonetalon and Kalimdor are indebted to you, noble $C.
BAccept this as your reward most honored one.

6601.name: Ascension...
desc: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.
objectives: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.
details: From the skulls of our enemies is shaped a medallion. You know this medallion, yesss? You have no doubt seen it worn by your elders.
BTake it, whelp. Return to the Spire and present it to General Drakkisath. The General will place the final enchantment upon the medallion, attuning the trinket to your spirit.
BYou will wear the finished medallion as a badge of honor, symbolizing your ascension to one of our most guarded ranks: Guardian to the brood mother.
BGo!
completion: It is merely dragon-talk, $N - more hot air than actual substantive information. Pompous, aggressive behavior is to be expected from their kind.

6625.name: Alliance Trauma
desc: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.
objectives: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.
details: Doctor $N, I presume. It is a pleasure to see you.

BI have some wonderful news for you! Gustaf VanHowzen, chief physician of Alliance Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Theramore. This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great doctor, Gustaf VanHowzen! Do not squander this opportunity, doctor!
completion: Wonderful. Put on your scrubs, we are to start at once!

6721.name: The Hunter's Path
desc: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.
objectives: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.
details: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
BYou must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.$B
completion: Yes, it is time, $C.

6961.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
desc: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
details: Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend! Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter! If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil. Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!

BAlso, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year. We have a great selection to choose from. Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
completion: Ho ho hello. I am Greatfather Winter, and I - courtesy of the fine folks of Smokywood Pastures... "Fresh from our farm to your plate, it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness" - would like to wish you a fantastic Feast of Winter Veil.
BIf you've been good this year, maybe you will receive treats from Smokywood Pastures as your treat for the Feast of Winter Veil. Huzzah.

7081.name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
desc: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
details: The graveyards in Alterac Valley are prized territories. Both the Horde and the Alliance fight savagely for these sacred grounds. Are you, $N, ready to join that fight?
BI want you to assault an enemy graveyard. Find a graveyard with a Horde banner in its midst, and pull it from the ground! Do that, and your task will be complete....
BBut if you can also hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then our troops will soon come to relieve you.
completion: Well done! Graveyards are vital to our control of Alterac Valley. When you capture one, you help ensure the Alliance's sovereignty here.
BGo now, $N. Reenter the battle, and if you see a graveyard under the Horde's control... you know what to do!

7201.name: The Last Element
desc: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.$B
details: There is work to be had for those venturing into the depths, $N.
BThe Dark Irons have mastered creation of extremely powerful golems.
BInitial reports from our spies indicate that the dwarves use a unique power source to give their creations incomparable killing power.

BJust imagine what we could do with our abominations if we could get our hands on this essence of the elements! Turn that city upside down if you must, but do not return until you have found the essence! Payment will be worth the risk.
completion: Wonderful! I will have these sent by courier to the Undercity at once!
BAs for you - here is payment, as promised. Keep the change, you filthy beast!

7321.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
desc: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.
details: Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...
BSpeaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.
BIf you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!
completion: My soothing turtle bisque will keep you warm on a cold night... if you care about that kind of thing.

7441.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
desc: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.
objectives: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
BReturn to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.
details: I had let my guard down for only one moment, stranger. In my haste to escape the grip of the fallen Prince, I was robbed. A most foul demon, the imp Pusillin, pilfered my book of incantations and the key to the once great halls of Eldre'Thalas.
BI no longer hold interest in the key, as I have exchanged my immortality for freedom, but I desperately need my book of incantations.
BFind the imp, Pusillin, and recover my book.
BSearch the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul for Pusillin.
completion: You have found it! A curse upon that miserable imp. Alas, my material possessions are meager at best. You may choose from what I have to offer.

7489.name: Lethtendris's Web
desc: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
objectives: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
details: The blood elf Lethtendris has overstepped her bounds. So eager was she to gather magical power that she defied her brethren and created a device of insidious design, a web meant to siphon the tainted magical energies of Dire Maul. Even now she gathers those energies and plans to release them against her enemies.
BLethtendris must be stopped. Find her within the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul, defeat her and bring her web to me so that it might be returned to more clear-headed blood elves for study.
completion: You have done well, $N. This web holds within it vast stores of the magic of Dire Maul, and I fear what damage may be unleashed if those energies were harnessed by one so irresponsible as Lethtendris. I am saddened by her death, but I know that she could never part with her web while alive.
BThank you, $N. I will send the web to students of magic more responsible than Lethtendris. They will be the new wardens of its power.

7633.name: An Introduction
completion: Your diligence and integrity has been noted, $C.

BWe are Ancients: Protectors of this once great forest. Our physical forms were destroyed 10,000 years ago when Archimonde and the Burning Legion marched upon Hyjal. Our spirits, however, remain intact.
BThere are tasks that we can offer. Tasks that if completed will open up the secrets of the Ancients to you.
BKnow this, should you complete these tasks, merely return to this rock and we shall answer the calling.

7657.name: Imperial Plate Helm
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya.
BAnd $N, wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

7729.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
desc: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.
objectives: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.
details: Taskmaster Scrange is looking for a few good men and women to help 'cull the competition' in the Searing Gorge.
BIf you are interested in this position, venture out into the Searing Gorge and slaughter every Dark Iron Taskmaster and Dark Iron Slaver that you see.
BReturn to Taskmaster Scrange when your clothes are bloody enough.
BYou'll know when they're bloody enough so don't ask.
completion: 15.9 pounds! That may be a new record for blood and gut weight on apparel! Congratulations, $C!

7849.name: Separation Anxiety
desc: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.

Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.
objectives: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.

BMarkhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.
details: Like many in our village, I too have lost a loved one to the wilds. Alas, it was my twin brother Malkhor - taken in the same raid as Torntusk's mate by the Vilebranch.
BSadly, he was not fated to live and was given a swift, brutal execution; his remains fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch.
BIt is too late to save his life but not too late to save his soul. Recover his remains, $N.
completion: My dearest brother, how I will miss you...
BThank you for your assistance, $N. You are truly a hero in my eyes.

7873.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
details: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young $c. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.
BEnter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces!
BDo this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, $N, and I shall reward you.
completion: NULL

8041.name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
completion: Hail, $c. I am Jin'rokh the Breaker, troll of Mugamba. We of the Zandalar tribe recognize your accomplishments. We salute your tenacity and strength of will.
BWear this talisman around your neck, $c. Let the strength of Mount Mugamba flow through your being. Be empowered as you strike down our enemies!

8065.name: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Tunic
desc: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Tabard. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Revered with Zandalar.
objectives: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Tabard. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Revered with Zandalar.
details: The ultimate symbol of a haruspex's power is what they wear, $N. Of these, the tunic symbolizes the connection between themselves and the divine wisdom they seek. It often weaves parts of the beasties they sacrifice into the tunic; this reminds them of the connection they have to their gifts.
BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do this, and a tunic seeping with the true power of a haruspex is yours.
completion: Impressive... you've successfully collected the required Paragons of Power, $N. Your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub for the Zandalar are legendary; hence forth, you'll be revered amongst the tribe. Here is your tunic, mighty $C!

8113.name: Pristine Enchanted South Seas Kelp
completion: $n mon, it been a good journey. Keep on with the killing and suppressing of Hakkar and he minions.

8161.name: Cut Arathor Supply Lines
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
objectives: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
details: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.

BYou can help us, $N. Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.
completion: NULL

8233.name: A Simple Request
desc: Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in Ravenholdt Manor.
objectives: Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in Ravenholdt Manor.
details: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt has requested your presence. The matter is secret, and I cannot say any more.
BRavenholdt Manor is located in the Hillsbrad Foothills -- look for a path in the mountains northwest of Durnhold Keep.
completion: Welcome, welcome, welcome! Please, $N, have a seat and discuss a simple matter with me.
BYou see, $N, I've recently lost something dear to me, and to put it bluntly, I want it back at all costs. There's something in it for you, don't worry about that! Oh yes, something very nice.
BNow, what say you $N... are you up for some adventure?

8257.name: Blood of Morphaz
desc: Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
objectives: Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
details: Now the last part, the second cure.
BThe green drake Morphaz is known to be immune to all forms of poison and disease -- many druids died to bring us this information. There is no doubt his blood is potent for our needs.

BA courier from the Cenarion Circle will take the parts you have already collected while you gather the last. Summon your allies and seek out the drake's lair in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar. Bring his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
completion: You have slain Morphaz and carried his blood to us... I can hardly believe this good news!
BWe will combine the ingredients at once and begin healing the trees and creatures of Felwood. It will take a lifetime to undo what has happened here, but you have given us the means to do it.

8281.name: Stepping Up Security
desc: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
objectives: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
details: Your performance has been truly exemplary so far, $N. Our supply lines are not completely safe yet, however. In the absence of dredge strikers, their larger southern cousins will surely move in to take their place in the north.
BYou'll have to kill quite a few dredge crushers to keep them at bay, but we cannot leave the safety of our supply lines to chance.
completion: Excellent! You've proven to be a valuable ally in preparing for the war against the silithid.

8305.name: Long Forgotten Memories
desc: Locate the Crystalline Tear in Silithus and gaze into its depths.
objectives: Locate the Crystalline Tear in Silithus and gaze into its depths.
details: In the southern desert of Silithus, near the sacred barrier, exists a single crystalline tear. This tear serves as a symbol of the great losses beset upon us during the War of the Shifting Sands. Locate this tear and gaze into its depths to gain enlightenment.$B
completion: You can feel a great sorrow revolving around this crystal. The force is so powerful that you feel as if you might collapse and die of sadness.

8377.name: Armaments of War
completion: War comes, $N, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
BShould this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
B<Geologist Larksbane turns pale.>
BThe future of us all could be at an end.
BThese armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.

8401.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest. There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than the preservationist philosophy the Silverwings espouse.

BThe forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack. Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens. Do your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders! For the Alliance!
completion: Good work, $N. Thanks to you, our natural defenses in Ashenvale will remain intact for another day.

8425.name: Voodoo Feathers
desc: Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
objectives: Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
details: Your honor has brought some peace to me. It is only right that I offer you something in return.
BMy weapons and armor were splendid in life, and yet they are of no use to me now. They would be better served in your possession.

BTravel to the sunken temple and destroy the troll guardians Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. They carry magic feathers that can reform my physical body long enough to grant you a reward.
completion: At last I can feel the cold touch of steel again, even if only for a moment.

8521.name: The Alliance Needs More Silk Bandages!

8545.name: The Horde Needs Mithril Bars!
desc: Bring 20 Mithril Bars to Senior Sergeant T'kelah at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 20 Mithril Bars to Senior Sergeant T'kelah at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: $C, the war it is comin' and the only thing we can do is prepare for it. That be where you and I can help each other, mon. Ya see, they put me in charge of collectin' all the mithril bars we be needin' ta build for all the things we gonna need. An I still be needin' more!
BSo, I be hopin' that you can get out there an mine us up some mithril, then smelt it into bars. Sound like something you can do for us?
completion: This be a good start for you an me, $C. That be another twenty mithril bars that I can be puttin' on the stacks an checkin' off of the list. It all gonna be put to good use makin' the war materiel.
BBe makin' sure that you check back in with me 'cuz you know it be lookin' like we gonna need even more of those mithril bars.

8689.name: Shroud of Infinite Wisdom
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Jasper Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Jasper Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.
BI shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.
BI promise you won't be disappointed.
completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.
BTake this cloak, $N. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.

8713.name: Starsong the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8761.name: The Grand Invoker

objectives.target: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

completion: Rise, Grand Invoker! Rise and be recognized!

8857.name: Secrets of the Colossus - Ashi
desc: Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
objectives: Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.$B
details: I'm looking for battle hardened adventurers willing and able to get a fresh husk sample from the fallen Colossus of Ashi to Oglethorpe in Booty Bay. No, no, I wouldn't want you to go anywhere near that thing's corpse. Just take one of my samples and make it snappy. These things are no good to him rotten!
completion: Oh the chickens I will craft from this wondrous husk! Well done, my $gboy:girl; !

8905.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: Well met, $c. I've something that might interest you.

BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
completion: Excellent! Let's perform the trade then. It's hard to part with this excellent armor, but I'm afraid I won't be needing it any time soon.
BIf you're interested in performing more work for me, I might be willing to give up the rest of the pieces.

8929.name: In Search of Anthion
desc: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
objectives: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
details: Well, nothing left for us to do but try out the goblin's invention. Word has it that Anthion was mowed down by the undead legions of Stratholme as he tried to enter its gates.
BTry using the device there and find out whatever Anthion knew.
completion: Deliana had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.

8953.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
objectives: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
BWell, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.

8977.name: Return to Deliana
desc: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: It's been great working with you, $N. Here is the finished product.
BI hope it helps you in your current endeavors. And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word. I wouldn't mind having more customers!
completion: Excellent! You've done well, $N. I'm not sure I trust the goblin's craftsmanship, but I'm left with no other choice.

9001.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Deliana your Magister's Crown and Magister's Robes.
objectives: Give Deliana your Magister's Crown and Magister's Robes.
details: That's an amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
completion: I'm going to miss you, $N. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.
BI hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.

9025.name: Morgan's Discovery
desc: Return to Aristan Mottar outside the bank in Stormwind's Trade District.
objectives: Return to Aristan Mottar outside the bank in Stormwind's Trade District.
details: Well, I'll be. It looks like Aristan might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in love potions and insidious mind-altering draughts.
BIt isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of them, but a few of the ingredients I detected... Smells funny.
completion: While I thought this would be the case, finding out that my suspicions were correct is still unsettling. We must carefully consider our next move.
BHere, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.

9121.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
desc: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.
objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.$B
details: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

BWe have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, $N, the price will be high. You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
completion: You will feel a slight tingle, $N. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.

9241.name: Polar Bracers
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 12 Enchanted Leather, 3 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 12 Enchanted Leather, 3 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold. $B
details: Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace), I am now able to create Polar bracers. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!

9265.name: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity
desc: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Undercity and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Undercity and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
details: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend the Undercity from these accursed invaders? $B $BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

objectives: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
*Quinn's Potion (provided)
details: Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.
Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.

objectives: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
*Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
details: It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not worry, but it's been days.
There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.

objectives: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
* Scrawny Ursera Claw (6)
details: The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.

objectives: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Tyr's Watch.
details: Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us.
You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, .

objectives: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
* Blood-Stained Letter (provided)
details: If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.
If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?

objectives: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
*Reed-woven Heart (provided)
details: I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.
Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.
Thank you.

objectives: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
*Forgotten Loa Idol (8)
details: When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.
The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.
This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.
Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.

objectives: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.
*Migi's Lunch (provided)
details: Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea.

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily.
Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
